if_external_exasol_mcp_is_unreachable.fallback: Call app_scaffold_from_schema with only profile_name (and optionally schema_name/table_name) to have dash-server introspect the schema itself through the same profile used at runtime, then generate a tailored dashboard scaffold from the discovered blueprint - no external MCP server required.
if_external_exasol_mcp_is_unreachable.note: The external Exasol MCP server is a separate, optional process; it can be unreachable, unconfigured, or fail (e.g. TLS certificate verification against a self-signed Exasol instance). dash-server does not depend on it for schema discovery.

recommended_workflow: Check for a governed semantic model first: SELECT MODEL_NAME, PUBLISHED_SCHEMA, DESCRIPTION FROM SEMANTIC_AGENT.MODELS_FOR_AGENT WHERE MODEL_STATUS = 'PUBLISHED'. If one covers the question, build on its published views, not the raw tables behind them (dash://exasol/help/semantic-layer).
Use the external Exasol MCP server to inspect schema, test candidate SQL, and understand the dataset.
Create or validate a dash-server Exasol profile with exasol_profile_create_local and exasol_profile_validate.

Create the hosted app with app_create_from_files (template=exasol-analytics) once you know what you are building - it takes your app.py and queries/*.sql directly and injects dash_server_exasol.py. Use app_scaffold_from_schema instead only while you are still exploring an unfamiliar schema, or app_create_exasol_dashboard for a prebuilt pattern as-is.
Copy only safe SQL and structural findings into queries/*.sql; keep credentials and connection setup in the dash-server profile.
Deploy to a preview URL first, then promote the approved revision live.

dash_server: Owns Exasol profile metadata and secret references for hosted dashboards.
Executes dashboard SQL at runtime through the configured profile.
Generates safe Exasol dashboard scaffolds and validates hosted app safety rules.
external_exasol_mcp: Explore schemas, tables, columns, and system metadata interactively.
Prototype and refine SQL during authoring time.
Help the agent understand business entities and available database structures.

rules: Use the external Exasol MCP server for discovery and SQL design, not for dashboard runtime execution.
Use dash-server profiles for hosted dashboards so credentials stay server-side.
Do not copy DSN, user, password, PAT, token, or raw secret values from Exasol MCP output into app files.
Do not make a hosted dashboard depend on live MCP tool calls. Put final runtime SQL in queries/*.sql and execute it through dash_server_exasol.py or server-side helpers.

Query helpers return typed values: DECIMAL columns come back as int or decimal.Decimal, DATE as datetime.date, and TIMESTAMP as datetime.datetime. Numbers with more than 15 significant digits and INTERVAL values stay strings, because a browser can't show them exactly. Format dates with strftime() and numbers with format specs; don't slice or concatenate them as strings. Convert with float() before mixing a Decimal into float arithmetic.
summary: How dash-server should coexist with a separate Exasol MCP server in agent workflows.
